say:1:1130503001:1.text: Robbing ain't a big deal. Who comes to the Eroded Enclave for anything but a payday?
say:1:1130503001:1.source_cn: 打劫没什么大不了的，谁来风蚀飞地不是为了发财？

say:2:1130503002:1.text: Exiled scum, greedy gold diggers, shifty bandits... law n' order's in short supply around these parts. As it stands, madness is the status quo.
